shortDescription: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Nov. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- HYTN Innovations Inc. CSE:HYTN (OTC Pink: HYTNF) FSE:85W0 (“HYTN”) and Peptide Development Labs Inc. CSE:PEPT (“PEPT”), further to their press release dated November 19, 2026, are pleased to announce that pursuant to a bulletin issued b…

children: ”), further to their press release dated November 19, 2026, are pleased to announce that pursuant to a bulletin issued by the Canadian Securities Exchange (the “
”) on November 19, 2026, PEPT has now met all final listing requirements of the CSE. Common shares of PEPT (“
”) will begin trading on the CSE at market open on November 20, 2026.
Under the statutory plan of arrangement involving HYTN and PEPT (the “
”), the shareholders of HYTN received PEPT Common Shares by way of a share exchange, pursuant to which each existing share of HYTN held at 12:01 a.m. on November 17, 2026 (a “
”) was exchanged for one “new” share of HYTN (“
”) and 0.0555555555555556 of a PEPT Common Share.
The CSE granted final acceptance of the Arrangement on November 19, 2026. PEPT Common Shares will begin trading on the CSE at market open on November 20, 2026.
As part of the Arrangement, HYTN reorganized its authorized share structure effective as at 12:01 a.m. on November 17, 2026 (the “

”). Under the Reclassification, HYTN’s existing common shares were redesignated as “Class A Common Shares” and a new class of “Class B Common Shares” was created, having rights, privileges, restrictions and conditions identical to those attaching to HYTN’s common shares immediately prior to the Reclassification. Each outstanding Class A Common Share was then exchanged for one Class B Common Share, the Class A Common Shares were cancelled and eliminated from HYTN’s authorized share structure, and the Class B Common Shares were redesignated as “Common Shares”, being the New HYTN Common Shares. Following the Reclassification, HYTN shareholders hold the same number of common shares of HYTN, in the same proportion, as they held immediately prior to the Reclassification.

The Arrangement, which included the Reclassification, was approved by HYTN shareholders at the annual general and special meeting of HYTN held on November 12, 2026. The record date for the Reclassification is November 17, 2026. The New HYTN Common Shares continue to trade on the CSE under the symbol “HYTN” with CUSIP 40443L203 and ISIN CA40443L2030, effective November 17, 2026.
New HYTN Common Shares trade on the CSE under HYTN’s current ticker symbol of “HYTN”. The CUSIP number assigned to the New HYTN Common Shares is 40443L203
PEPT Common Shares will trade on the CSE under the ticker symbol “PEPT”. The CUSIP number assigned to the PEPT Common Shares is 713467108

HYTN formulates, manufactures, markets, and sells premium products containing psychoactive and psychotropic compounds, including cannabis-derived cannabinoids. HYTN’s mission is to become the top provider of these products in all federally regulated markets. To achieve this, HYTN focuses on identifying market opportunities and quickly bringing its innovative products to market through its elevated development platform.

PEPT is a Canadian pharmaceutical development company focused on advancing investigational peptide-based drug candidates through established regulatory pathways. PEPT’s mission is to develop peptide candidates that may address defined areas of unmet clinical need within a conventional pharmaceutical framework. To achieve this, PEPT focuses on advancing its investigational subcutaneous BPC-157 drug candidate for refractory ligament disorders through GMP-controlled supply, pharmaceutical quality systems, physician-led access, structured data generation and formal clinical development.
